fields.description: Ordered, typed composition blocks rendered top to bottom under the page header. Each entry picks a Kind; the renderer reads only the fields that Kind uses and ignores the rest. An unknown Kind renders nothing, so new archetypes can be authored before the site ships them.
fields.name: sections

fields.description: split = two columns divided by a vertical hairline (uses the first two Items). timeline = period rail on the left, title and body on the right (Items, one per row; Item overline is the period). featureGrid = two or three columns, one hairline cap per cell (Items). callout = a banded statement with the one solid-fill button on the site (Title, Body, CTA). steps = numbered sequence, one overline per step (Items). quote = a single pulled sentence with an attribution.
